verdict.rationale: Twenty provides REST and GraphQL endpoints for built-in objects like Company and Person, with batch create/upsert, and lists an MCP server on every plan. Its docs also describe AI agents that autonomously enrich records within role-scoped permissions, and workflows that auto-enrich new contacts from external APIs; a community user reports the REST API 'worked ok'. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of assigning a record owner via API/agent, any MCP server documentation beyond a pricing-table line, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent enrichment flow.
